preconditions.description: The length of the string n must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of allowed characters p must be between 1 and 26.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'[:p] for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length n and consist only of the first p letters of the English alphabet.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (len(stdout) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'[:p] for c in stdout) and not any(stdout[i:i+2] == stdout[i+1:i:-1] for i in range(n-1)))
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'NO', it must be a tolerable string of length n that is lexicographically larger than s.
